occurrenceChecks.text: The children of Gershon had thirteen cities by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, out of the tribe of Asher, out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Bashan.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: JOS固定WEB本文でゲルションの子らを明記。

occurrenceChecks.text: They gave to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the half-tribe of Manasseh Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, the city of refuge for the man slayer, and Be Eshterah with its pasture lands: two cities.
occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: JOS固定WEB本文でゲルションの子らを明記。
